main.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a production-ready single application icon for a Chinese educational desktop app called Future Classroom (未来教室), with NO text or letters. A distinctive blue and white rounded-square emblem combining a simple open book and a bright classroom window, calm vivid azure #087bff and white, polished flat softly dimensional design, strong silhouette recognizable at 16 pixels. Center one icon occupying 82% of square canvas, clean thick shapes, no thin details, no mockup, no surrounding objects, no checkerboard. Genuinely transparent background outside rounded square. Suitable for Windows EXE, desktop shortcut, start menu and website favicon. Save generated output for project use.
